title: The Chair from the Other Room
youtube_title: The Chair from the Other Room | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Kei sees that a chair that could be carried in from the other room will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Kei makes a smaller, even share so Ximena is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
